title: Watch the Optimizer Fold
prompt: Implement `int folded(void)` whose body computes `21 * 2` through plain automatic locals and returns it. Then implement `int unfolded(void)` doing the same multiplication but through a `volatile int`. Return the difference `folded() - unfolded()`; it must be 0 (folding changes nothing observable), which is the standard's own guarantee.

tests.name: difference is zero
tests.hint: Both must compute 42; volatile merely forces a runtime load/store.

tests.name: both functions real
tests.hint: Both must exist as real, addressable functions — taking their addresses is the observation.
